data.name: Ghost Truck: Death Arena
data.detailed_description:
GHOSTS, TRUCKS, & DEATH ARENAS

GHOST TRUCK: DEATH ARENA is an ONLINE, 4-player monster truck arena combat game where you use GHOST-POWERED MONSTER TRUCKS to crash into your opponents to destroy them before they can destroy you! The event is hosted by a hot-headed announcer, who will throw your tormented souls into her arena to decide who deserves their spot in the afterlife!

THE GOAL OF GHOST TUCK: DEATH ARENA

ATTACK other players by slamming your GHOST TRUCK into them as hard and as fast as possible. To help you in destroying other players use POWER UPS, giving you the edge you need to outplay and demolish as much as you can!

Players are ELIMINATED if their ghost trucks ARMOR breaks and exposes their vulnerable inner skeletons core to deal extra damage. 

To WIN rack up the highest score count by CAUSING THE MOST DESTRUCTION!

GHOSTLY & GHOULISH FEATURES 

Smash through POWER UPS to gain ghostly ABILITIES! They'll spawn randomly around the arenas so make sure to learn their patterns and how best to use them!

BATTLE IN THREE HELLISH ARENAS

RAVEYARD

With its bright lights, overcast skulls and remains of previous contestants - it has become the Announcer's favorite arena to torment her subjects.

WHALE BONE ABYSS

A deep blue battleground under the sea at the very bottom of the underworld.

HELLWAY

A unique twist on the usual formula, forcing competitors to speed down a massive ramp and launch themselves into various vortexes to earn points. 

PLAY AS STYLISH GHOULS & GHOSTS

You play as the spirit of a fierce competitor possessing a GHOST TRUCK. These vengeful ghosts are seeking their second chance in the afterlife by battling it out in the arena, after meeting a particularly unfortunate death in life.

HINEWAI - Known to locals as "The Daughter of the Waves" in life, she met her fate after a surfing accident left her head too close to the propeller of a boat. Now, Hinewai seeks to show the underworld how she earned her name and claim her spot in the afterlife by making waves with her GHOST TRUCK - HINEWAI'S WAKE.

VESPA - Vespa met her untimely fate while street racing her motorbike. Her speed finally caught up to her as she crashed into a wasp nest - their stings promptly sending her speeding into the afterlife. Now, Just try to catch Vespa in her GHOST TRUCK when she zips by causing you a DEATH BY A THOUSAND STINGS! 

LUIS - In life Luis was a famed Luchador known for his Heart of Gold, inspiring kindness in others. But in the wrestling ring he was known for his Muscles of Steel. Once he had someone in his grip they were never able to break his hold. However - in his final match he took a brutal hit to the head. Now, in the arena Luis bashes that same love for the ring over your head with his GHOST TRUCK - the STEEL CHAIR!

DORIS - Grandma Doris was beloved by all her grandchildren for always baking them whatever treats they asked for, doing this for 100 years she earned the title of "Master of Baked Goods". Her bold personality and reputation spread across the world where she was invited to compete in the King of Baked Goods Tournament where sabotage from a jealous rival led to her demise. Now in the arena, she has a taste for destruction. Possessing her GHOST TRUCK she intends to give all who oppose her some of GRANDMA'S KISSES!

data.short_description: Ghost Truck: Death Arena is a 4-player monster truck arena fighter where you dash and crash into your opponents to destroy them before they can destroy you! Use ghoulish power-ups and speed boosts to aid in your efforts to secure your soul a first place spot in the afterlife.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super / RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
